description.value: Yaletown Liquor Store is a premium bottle shop in Vancouver's historic Yaletown neighbourhood, offering a curated selection of wines, beers, spirits, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages from around the world. The store features a large cold beer fridge and knowledgeable staff who provide personalized pairing recommendations. Delivery is available through Skip the Dishes and Uber Eats for cyclists who prefer doorstep convenience.
